name: Imprecasia
source: Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web

generalAbilities.name: Scent Curse
generalAbilities.description: The imprecasia can smell the presence of curses of a level equal to or lower than their own level within 30 feet; this is an imprecise sense.

defensiveAbilities.name: Drink Death
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet of the imprecasia is Dying

Effect The imprecasia inhales, drawing a thin blue streak of vapor out of the dying creature's body into their mouth. The dying creature's dying condition is reduced by 1, and the imprecasia regains (2d10+9) Healing Damage Hit Points.

offensiveAbilities.name: Devour Curse
offensiveAbilities.description:
The imprecasia casts Cleanse Affliction against a curse afflicting a creature, but with a cast of two actions rather than 10 minutes. If they succeed in removing the curse, they also drains vitality from the creature, causing it to become Drained 1 unless it succeeds at a DC 30 Fortitude Saving Throw save (Drained 2 on a critical failure). If the curse is removed, the imprecasia doesn't expend that use of remove curse as a primal innate spell.

Targeting Items

An imprecasia can cast remove curse on a cursed item rather than on a creature, but they can't use Devour Curse on it. They can only do so on an item that's of a level equal to or less than their own level; on a success, the item is uncursed for 24 hours if it's of a level equal to or higher than the imprecasia's level –4, or uncursed permanently if it's lower level than that.

offensiveAbilities.name: Homeland's Hostility
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature that takes damage from the imprecasia's claws must attempt a DC 30 Will Saving Throw save. On a failure, it treats all terrain within 60 feet of an imprecasia as difficult terrain.

cantrips.name: Tangle Vine
cantrips.description:
A vine appears from thin air, flicking from your hand and lashing itself to the target. Attempt a spell attack roll against the target.

Critical Success The target gains the Immobilized condition and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty and the immobilized condition.

Success The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Heightened (2nd) The effects last for 2 rounds.

Heightened (4th) The effects last for 1 minute.

lv5spells.name: Cleanse Affliction (Curse Only)
lv5spells.description:
Gentle restorative magic pushes back the effects of toxins and more complex maladies. Choose an affliction on the target, such as a curse, disease, or poison. If it has advanced past stage one, reduce the stage by one. This reduction can be applied only once to a given case of an affliction, with the case ending when it's completely cured. Although the reduction can't occur again, heightened versions of this spell attempt to counteract with each casting.

Heightened (3rd) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a disease or poison.

Heightened (4th) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a curse, disease, or poison.

lv5spells.name: Deafness
lv5spells.description:
The target loses hearing; it must attempt a Fortitude save. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Deafened for 1 round.

Failure The target is Deafened for 10 minutes.

Critical Failure The target is Deafened permanently.

lv5spells.name: Blindness
lv5spells.description:
You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Blinded until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

lv5spells.name: Mirage
lv5spells.description:
You create an illusion that causes natural terrain to look, sound, feel, and smell like a different kind of terrain. This doesn't disguise any structures or creatures in the area.

Any creature that touches the illusion or uses the Seek action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (5th) Your image can also disguise structures or create illusory structures (but still doesn't disguise creatures).
